slots.purpose: Hero and social share image: a Hawaiian coastline wedding setting that signals luxury and sets up a practical step-by-step guide.
slots.shot_brief: Landscape 3:2 with room for a title overlay. Ceremony set-up on an oceanfront lawn or terrace at a real, named Hawaiian resort or estate, volcanic coastline or palms in frame, golden-hour light, calm sea, white and tropical florals, no signage. Couple optional and small in frame. People only from a licensed real wedding with written couple consent (and guest consent if identifiable) recorded in library-index.csv; never AI people, never stock models presented as a real couple. No sacred or culturally restricted sites (for example heiau) and no Native Hawaiian cultural practice shown as decoration; any cultural element (lei, oli, kahu) only from a consented real wedding. Source order: venue or resort media kit with written permission (Gmail draft request, never sent by an agent); Hawaii Tourism Authority media library only if its licence terms cover commercial blog use by a third party ([[VERIFY licence]], record terms and credit in library-index.csv); licensed premium stock bought by a human and added to the register. Never AI, never a competitor, directory, planner, photographer-blog or search-result image. Location proven by media kit, register row or EXIF, never by appearance.
